title: Chapter11
description: Finnish vocabulary: education, work, professions, careers and verbs

questions.question: Adult education
questions.explanation: 'Aikuiskoulutus' means adult education; its genitive is 'aikuiskoulutuksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I take part in adult education.

questions.question: Driver's license
questions.explanation: 'Ajokortti' means driver's license; its genitive is 'ajokortin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I get my driver's license this year.

questions.question: Field / Sector
questions.exampletranslate: I work in the IT field.

questions.question: Primary school (lower)
questions.explanation: 'Alakoulu' means the lower grades of comprehensive school (primary school).

questions.question: Beginning
questions.exampletranslate: The course's beginning is in September.

questions.question: University of applied sciences
questions.exampletranslate: I study at a university of applied sciences.

questions.question: Vocational school
questions.exampletranslate: He studies to be a cook at a vocational school.

questions.question: Grant / Scholarship
questions.exampletranslate: I got a grant for my studies.

questions.question: Everyday life / Weekday
questions.explanation: 'Arki' means everyday life or weekday; its genitive is 'arjen'.

questions.question: Pension
questions.exampletranslate: He will soon retire (go on pension).

questions.question: To separate / divorce
questions.explanation: 'Erota' (type 4 verb) means to separate, resign or divorce; 'eroan' is 'I separate' (used with 'mistä').

questions.question: Supervisor / Manager
questions.explanation: 'Esihenkilö' means supervisor or manager (a person's superior).

questions.question: To dream (of)
questions.explanation: 'Haaveilla' (type 3 verb) means to dream of; 'haaveilen' is 'I dream' (used with 'mistä').
questions.exampletranslate: I dream of my own company.

questions.question: Application round / Search
questions.explanation: 'Haku' means a search or an application round; its genitive is 'haun'.
questions.exampletranslate: The university application round begins in spring.

questions.question: Pity / Annoyance
questions.exampletranslate: What a pity, I didn't get into the school.

questions.question: To bury
questions.explanation: 'Haudata' (type 4 verb) means to bury; 'hautaan' is 'I bury'.
questions.exampletranslate: He was buried at the cemetery.

questions.question: To admire
questions.explanation: 'Ihailla' (type 3 verb) means to admire; 'ihailen' is 'I admire'.

questions.question: To appear
questions.explanation: 'Ilmestyä' (type 1 verb) means to appear; 'ilmestyn' is 'I appear'.
questions.exampletranslate: The new book appears in spring.

questions.question: To vacuum
questions.explanation: 'Imuroida' (type 2 verb) means to vacuum; 'imuroin' is 'I vacuum'.

questions.question: To stay / remain (into a place)
questions.explanation: 'Jäädä' (type 2 verb) means to stay or remain; 'jään' is 'I stay' (used with 'mihin').

questions.question: Roof / Ceiling
questions.explanation: 'Katto' means roof or ceiling; its genitive is 'katon'.

questions.question: Season / Period
questions.explanation: 'Kausi' means season or period; its genitive is 'kauden'.

questions.question: Seasonal work
questions.exampletranslate: I do seasonal work in summer.

questions.question: Story / Account
questions.explanation: 'Kertomus' means story or account; its genitive is 'kertomuksen'.

questions.question: Unfinished / In the middle
questions.explanation: 'Kesken' means in the middle or unfinished.

questions.question: Summer job
questions.exampletranslate: I am looking for a summer job.

questions.question: Language skill
questions.explanation: 'Kielitaito' means language skill; its genitive is 'kielitaidon'.
questions.exampletranslate: Good language skills help at work.

questions.question: Interested (in)
questions.explanation: 'Kiinnostunut' means interested; its genitive is 'kiinnostuneen' (used with 'mistä').

questions.question: Higher education institution
questions.exampletranslate: He studies at a higher education institution.

questions.question: Education / Training
questions.explanation: 'Koulutus' means education or training; its genitive is 'koulutuksen'.

questions.question: Village
questions.exampletranslate: I live in a small village.

questions.question: Helmet
questions.exampletranslate: Wear a helmet on the bike.

questions.question: To translate / turn
questions.explanation: 'Kääntää' (type 1 verb) means to translate or turn; 'käännän' is 'I translate/turn'.
questions.exampletranslate: I translate the text into Finnish.

questions.question: Law book
questions.exampletranslate: The lawyer reads the law book.

questions.question: To cut
questions.explanation: 'Leikata' (type 4 verb) means to cut; 'leikkaan' is 'I cut'.
questions.exampletranslate: I cut the paper with scissors.

questions.question: Business economics
questions.explanation: 'Liiketalous' means business economics; its genitive is 'liiketalouden'.

questions.question: Bus (coach)
questions.exampletranslate: I go to work by bus.

questions.question: Slippery
questions.exampletranslate: The road is slippery in winter.

questions.question: Practical nurse
questions.exampletranslate: She works as a practical nurse.

questions.question: Medicine (the science)
questions.explanation: 'Lääketiede' means medicine (the academic field); its genitive is 'lääketieteen'.

questions.question: World war
questions.explanation: 'Maailmansota' means world war; its genitive is 'maailmansodan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The Second World War ended in 1945.

questions.question: To paint
questions.explanation: 'Maalata' (type 4 verb) means to paint; 'maalaan' is 'I paint'.

questions.question: In the countryside
questions.exampletranslate: My parents live in the countryside.

questions.question: Possibility / Opportunity
questions.explanation: 'Mahdollisuus' means possibility or opportunity; its genitive is 'mahdollisuuden'.

questions.question: Mark / Brand / Sign
questions.explanation: 'Merkki' means mark, brand or sign; its genitive is 'merkin'.

questions.question: Metal
questions.exampletranslate: He works in the metal industry.

questions.question: Meter / Gauge
questions.exampletranslate: The taxi's meter shows the price.

questions.question: Many
questions.explanation: 'Monta' means many (the partitive form used in counting).

questions.question: Moped
questions.exampletranslate: The young person rides a moped.

questions.question: Note (written)
questions.exampletranslate: I take notes in the lecture.

questions.question: To be late
questions.explanation: 'Myöhästyä' (type 1 verb) means to be late; 'myöhästyn' is 'I am late'.
questions.exampletranslate: I was late for (missed) the bus.

questions.question: Fixed-term
questions.exampletranslate: I have a fixed-term work contract.

questions.question: Current / Present
questions.explanation: 'Nykyinen' means current or present; its genitive is 'nykyisen'.

questions.question: Accident
questions.exampletranslate: An accident happened on the road.

questions.question: Study place (admission)
questions.explanation: 'Opiskelupaikka' means a study place (admission to study); its genitive is 'opiskelupaikan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I got a study place at the university.

questions.question: Drawing
questions.exampletranslate: The child's drawing is on the wall.

questions.question: Project
questions.exampletranslate: I work on a new project.

questions.question: To stay / remain (the same)
questions.explanation: 'Pysyä' (type 1 verb) means to stay or remain; 'pysyn' is 'I stay'.

questions.question: To stop (come to a halt)
questions.explanation: 'Pysähtyä' (type 1 verb) means to stop or come to a halt; 'pysähdyn' is 'I stop'.
questions.exampletranslate: The bus stops at the stop.

questions.question: To wipe
questions.explanation: 'Pyyhkiä' (type 1 verb) means to wipe; 'pyyhin' is 'I wipe'.

questions.question: Chief / Manager
questions.explanation: 'Päällikkö' means chief or manager; its genitive is 'päällikön'.
questions.exampletranslate: He is the head of the department.

questions.question: To fall in love
questions.explanation: 'Rakastua' (type 1 verb) means to fall in love; 'rakastun' is 'I fall in love' (used with 'mihin').
questions.exampletranslate: I fell in love with her immediately.

questions.question: Steering wheel
questions.explanation: 'Ratti' means steering wheel; its genitive is 'ratin'.
questions.exampletranslate: Keep both hands on the steering wheel.

questions.question: To be enough / suffice
questions.explanation: 'Riittää' (type 1 verb) means to be enough or suffice; 'se riittää' means 'it is enough'.

questions.question: Similar / Identical
questions.explanation: 'Samanlainen' means similar or identical; its genitive is 'samanlaisen'.

questions.question: Contract / Agreement
questions.explanation: 'Sopimus' means contract or agreement; its genitive is 'sopimuksen'.

questions.question: Shelter / Protection
questions.exampletranslate: I look for shelter from the rain.

questions.question: To be born
questions.explanation: 'Syntyä' (type 1 verb) means to be born; 'synnyn' is 'I am born'.

questions.question: Exact / Precise
questions.explanation: 'Tarkka' means exact or precise; its genitive is 'tarkan'.
questions.exampletranslate: He is precise in his work.

questions.question: To mean
questions.explanation: 'Tarkoittaa' (type 1 verb) means to mean; 'tarkoitan' is 'I mean' (takes a partitive object).

questions.question: Technology / Technique
questions.explanation: 'Tekniikka' means technology or technique; its genitive is 'tekniikan'.

questions.question: Shipyard / Dock
questions.explanation: 'Telakka' means shipyard or dock; its genitive is 'telakan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The ship is built at the shipyard.

questions.question: Computer program
questions.exampletranslate: I use a new computer program.

questions.question: Accounting firm
questions.exampletranslate: She works at an accounting firm.

questions.question: Activity / Operation
questions.explanation: 'Toiminta' means activity or operation; its genitive is 'toiminnan'.

questions.question: The day before yesterday
questions.exampletranslate: I started the job the day before yesterday.

questions.question: Bachelor of business administration
questions.explanation: 'Tradenomi' is a bachelor of business administration (a Finnish degree title).

questions.question: Fire (blaze)
questions.exampletranslate: A fire broke out in the house.

questions.question: Degree (qualification)
questions.explanation: 'Tutkinto' means degree or qualification; its genitive is 'tutkinnon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I completed a higher education degree.

questions.question: Construction site / Workplace site
questions.explanation: 'Työmaa' means construction site or work site.
questions.exampletranslate: He works at the construction site.

questions.question: To work
questions.explanation: 'Työskennellä' (type 3 verb) means to work; 'työskentelen' is 'I work'.

questions.question: Work shift
questions.exampletranslate: I have a morning shift as my work shift.

questions.question: Career
questions.exampletranslate: I want to build a good career.

questions.question: Gear
questions.exampletranslate: I change gear in the car.

questions.question: To graduate
questions.explanation: 'Valmistua' (type 1 verb) means to graduate; 'valmistun' is 'I graduate' (used with 'miksi' = as what).
questions.exampletranslate: I graduate as a doctor next year.

questions.question: Elderly person
questions.explanation: 'Vanhus' means elderly person; its genitive is 'vanhuksen'.

questions.question: Free time
questions.explanation: 'Vapaa-aika' means free time; its genitive is 'vapaa-ajan'.
questions.exampletranslate: In my free time I do music.

questions.question: Responsibility
questions.exampletranslate: I have a big responsibility at work.

questions.question: Website
questions.exampletranslate: I check the information on the website.

questions.question: To spend (time) / celebrate
questions.explanation: 'Viettää' (type 1 verb) means to spend time or to celebrate; 'vietän' is 'I spend/celebrate'.
questions.exampletranslate: I spend my free time in nature.

questions.question: To enjoy / feel comfortable
questions.explanation: 'Viihtyä' (type 1 verb) means to enjoy oneself or feel comfortable; 'viihdyn' is 'I feel comfortable'.

questions.question: Mistake / Error
questions.explanation: 'Virhe' means mistake or error; its genitive is 'virheen'.

questions.question: Shift work
questions.exampletranslate: I do shift work at the hospital.

questions.question: To dye / color
questions.explanation: 'Värjätä' (type 4 verb) means to dye or color; 'värjään' is 'I dye'.

questions.question: Higher / Upper
questions.explanation: 'Ylempi' means higher or upper; its genitive is 'ylemmän'.

questions.question: Graduate (matriculation)
questions.explanation: 'Ylioppilas' means a matriculated graduate (one who passed the upper secondary exam); its genitive is 'ylioppilaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: He became a graduate in the spring.

questions.question: Upper comprehensive school
questions.explanation: 'Yläkoulu' means the upper grades of comprehensive school.
questions.exampletranslate: The teenager attends upper comprehensive school.

questions.question: Company / Attempt
questions.explanation: 'Yritys' means company or business (and also an attempt); its genitive is 'yrityksen'.

questions.question: Silent / Mute
questions.explanation: 'Äänetön' means silent or mute; its genitive is 'äänettömän'.
questions.exampletranslate: The phone is on silent in the meeting.

questions.question: Voice / Sound
questions.explanation: 'Ääni' means voice or sound; its genitive is 'äänen'.
